Hebrew translations of Gilgamesh – records only (not downloadable legally)

Retrieved / checked: 2026-10-16. Nothing in this folder was downloaded. These are copyrighted commercial books. The freely available Hebrew items are in ../Ben-Yehuda--Tchernichovsky-1924/ and ../Wasserman-Cohen-2026--Carmel-he/.

# Work Translator(s) Publisher, year Availability / price (Oct 2026) Notes
1 עלילות גילגמש (new translation + literary commentary) נתן וסרמן ויורם כהן כרמל, ירושלים 2026 ₪118 list. Carmel ₪59, e-vrit e-book ₪26 Full record in ../Wasserman-Cohen-2026--Carmel-he/README.md. Top recommendation.
2 בימים הרחוקים ההם: אנתולוגיה משירת המזרח הקדום ש. שפרה ויעקב קליין עם עובד (ספריה לעם), תל אביב 1996 (תשנ"ז); 744 pp.; ISBN 978-965-580-083-8 (as listed by Am Oved) Am Oved site ₪151.20 (list ₪168), "add to cart" active. No e-book found. https://www.am-oved.co.il/בימים-הרחוקים-ההם Translated from Sumerian and Akkadian by the poet Sh. Shifra (1931–2012) with the Assyriologist Jacob Klein (Bar-Ilan). It contains the Gilgamesh epic; the flood (Tablet XI) is at pp. 88–130 per the ibrith.wordpress.com bibliography (unverified). Poetic, biblical-syntax Hebrew. It was the scholarly standard 1996–2026 and was cited in Hebrew Wikipedia and in courses. It predates George 2003.
3 עלילות גילגמש: סיפור הידידות בין גילגמש המלך וידידו אנכידו ש. שפרה; illus. בלהה ומנשה קדישמן עם עובד 2000 Out of print? (second-hand only; not on the Am Oved site in my search) A retelling/adaptation for younger readers, based on her translation. Not suitable as a philological comparison.
4 המיתולוגיה הבבלית (סדרת "מיתוסים" 10) אורי גבאי ותמר וייס מפה, תל אביב 2003 (תשס"ג); 232 pp. Second-hand (Mapa is defunct) Gabbay is a HUJI Assyriologist. The book gives a prose Hebrew version of Gilgamesh (incl. the flood) and other myths, with an afterword, index and map. Its prose is close to the content, without verse lines.
5 עלילות גילגמש מלך ארך שמואל פרידמן ש. פרידמן, 1992 Second-hand A translation-adaptation from English (per Hebrew Wikipedia, citing Shifra 2004). Low value.
6 Sh. Shifra, "האישה, הדעת והמות: עלילות גלגמש – יצירה חתרנית: מבוא" — על הפרק 20 (Dec 2004) Print journal (CET/Ministry of Education). Not found online An essay, cited by Hebrew Wikipedia for the claim that Tchernichovsky translated from German.
7 Mikranet (CET) summary of the epic by Sh. Shifra — http://mikranet.cet.ac.il/pages/item.asp?item=12986 Dead link (flagged broken on Wikipedia 2022). Try the Wayback Machine —
8 Jacob Klein, chapter on Mesopotamian literature and the Bible, in ספרות המקרא: מבואות ומחקרים, vol. 2 — יד יצחק בן־צבי, ירושלים 2011 (p. 546 on Dilmun / "mouth of the rivers") Paid It has Klein's Hebrew renderings of flood passages and Sumerian parallels.
— אנציקלופדיה מקראית, entries "מבול", "גלגמש" — מוסד ביאליק, 1950–1988 Paid / library (no legal free online text found) It has the classic Israeli scholarly treatment of the flood parallels.

"?" = not visible in the freely accessible part of the book; check it in the purchased copy. Recommendation: follow Wasserman–Cohen 2026 (Israeli Assyriological standard: ח for ḫ, ש for š, no mimation in Ūta-napišti, Uruk = אוּרוּךּ).
